title: Activate Pro, check validity, and deactivate this device
summary: Enter the purchase email and activation code, then manage the two-device allowance.
outcome: The current computer will show Pro status, and you will know how to free an old device slot when switching computers.
before: Have the email used for purchase and the activation code you received.
Confirm that the computer can reach license.tradereplay.dev.
One activation code can be used on up to two devices at the same time.

sections.title: 1. Enter the email and activation code

media.label: Email and activation code under Settings → License
media.alt: TradeReplay License settings with fields for the purchase email and activation code

sections.body:
Open Settings → License, enter the purchase email and activation code, then select Activate.

When copying, avoid leading or trailing spaces. The email must match the one used for purchase.

sections.title: 2. Check the license status
sections.body:
After successful activation, the page displays Pro, a perpetual license, or an expiry date. The main window also shows the Pro badge.

When a time-limited license expires, existing data is not deleted. New actions follow Free-plan limits.

sections.title: 3. Deactivate before changing devices

media.label: Check the license status and deactivate the current device
media.alt: Video showing TradeReplay Pro license status and the deactivate-current-device action

sections.body:
While the old computer is still available, open the License page and deactivate the current device. Then enter the same email and activation code on the new computer.

Deactivation frees a license slot; it does not delete the library on the old computer.

success: The License page shows Pro and the correct validity period.
The main window no longer asks for activation.
Deactivation releases the current device slot.

faq.q: What should I do when all device slots are in use?
faq.a: Deactivate a device you no longer use. If the old device is unavailable, contact official support so the purchase can be verified and the device slot handled.

faq.q: Does activation upload my trade data?
faq.a: No. Activation verifies the license and device allowance; it does not require uploading trade records.
